title: Numerical-dimension-one log abundance in characteristic above three
exact_target: Over any algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, must the rational Cartier adjoint $K_X+B$ of every normal projective lc threefold pair with effective rational boundary be semiample whenever it is nef and has numerical dimension one?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Over any algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, must the rational Cartier adjoint $K_X+B$ of every normal projective lc threefold pair with effective rational boundary be semiample whenever it is nef and has numerical dimension one?

\subsection{Short English statement}
Over any algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, must the rational Cartier adjoint $K_X+B$ of every normal projective lc threefold pair with effective rational boundary be semiample whenever it is nef and has numerical dimension one?
